description: Audit current discovery package (packages/api-core/discovery/resolve.go) and design the vrooli-events architecture. Covers: structured event ID scheme ({scenario}.{domain}.{action}.{version}), event envelope proto contract, policy model (access control, rate limiting, circuit breaking), dual-end policy cache strategy (sender-side in discovery package, receiver-side middleware), SSE pub/sub protocol for event subscriptions and policy push, SQLite event store schema with configurable retention window and size-based pruning, fire-and-forget emission pattern that adds zero latency to inter-scenario calls. Deliverable: architecture doc + proto schema draft in packages/proto/schemas/vrooli-events/v1/.
name: vrooli-events-architecture
title: Design The Event Bus Architecture And Policy Model
